Crime & Law · India

Student Alleges Police Harassment After Protesting; Moves Supreme Court

Ghaziabad student Junaid Malik has filed a petition in the Supreme Court alleging police harassment of his family. Malik, who reportedly provided food to CJP protesters, claims police visited his home and questioned his family. Delhi police are investigating claims that some protesters may have used AI to counter crowd-control measures. Separately, INDIA bloc MPs have sought answers regarding alleged force used on NEET protesters.
